aiHeadlines: 📊 Wolves top the EFL Championship on 15 points after 6 rounds.
🧱 Nobody is harder to score on than Wolves: 2 conceded all season.
⚽ Wolves have the sharpest attack in the EFL Championship: 10 scored in 4 rounds.

boardObjectives.label: Have 1 player from England in the squad
Have 1 player aged 30 or over in the squad

inbox.text: Tomas Molina pulled you aside after training. The short version: he wants to start on Saturday.
Tomas Molina's agent has been in touch about his minutes. Politely, for now.
One of your forwards is selling his own brand of protein cereal in the players lounge. One of your defenders reckons it tastes like drywall.

academy.preview: The head of youth likes this group. There should be one worth keeping.

pending.text: 3 defeats in your last 5. Have you lost the dressing room?

options.label: These players are with me
options.line: You put your arm round the lot of them in public. Upstairs, that read as excuses.

options.label: That one is on me
options.line: You took it on the chin. The board respect it. The press smell a man under pressure.

options.label: Some of them were not at it
options.line: You named no names and everybody knew who you meant. It went round the dressing room by teatime.

options.label: We go again Saturday
options.line: Four words and a walk out. They will find something else to write about.

decisions.text: Andre Gudmundsson was shown a straight red against Charlton Athletic and is banned for 2 matches. The club secretary rates an appeal at 40 percent. Win and the ban is wiped. Lose and the panel makes it 3 matches. It has to go in before the next match.
decisions.resolved: No appeal went in before the next match, so the 2 matches ban stood.

decisions.text: A sponsor wants the squad at a photo shoot on the day off and will pay £200k for the afternoon. The supporters trust has asked for the same afternoon for an open day at the training ground, and the local paper wants to cover it.
decisions.resolved: Nobody answered before the next match, so nothing changed.

decisions.text: A columnist has written that your side has no plan. The press officer wants to know whether you will answer it.
decisions.resolved: Nobody answered before the next match, so nothing changed.

decisions.text: The board want you at an investors dinner on Thursday. A paper has asked for a long sit down interview the same evening.
decisions.resolved: Nobody answered before the next match, so nothing changed.
